scope: Static source-and-USD audit only; no Isaac startup, EULA acceptance, GPU initialization, controller construction, simulator action, or behavioral denominator.

zero_state_frame_comparison.method: PXR UsdGeom.XformCache versus exact CuRobo UsdKinematicsParser _get_joint_transform composition (localPos0 * inverse(localPos1)); matrices are Gf row-major.
zero_state_frame_comparison.result: The direct USD parser is frame-wrong at zero state; it is not eligible for controller use.

parser_and_collision_decision.direct_usd_parser: The pinned parser can open a USD but is explicitly experimental, cannot read mimic joints, and omits link geometry transformations after joints.
parser_and_collision_decision.collision: The parser supplies no collision meshes or spheres. CuRobo requires separately authored collision_spheres keyed by collision_link_names; its USD helper flattens/copies for visualization and does not export an exact URDF/XRDF/collision configuration.
parser_and_collision_decision.decision: No 10D-to-8D CuRobo action is authorized from the direct USD parser, and no Panda or unrelated Robotiq asset may substitute.

future_release_requirements: Hash-freeze an exact full USD-to-kinematics adapter that preserves link transforms and the Robotiq coupling.
Hash-freeze a collision representation derived from the exact USD, including arm, adapter, and Robotiq collision prims.
Independently compare forward kinematics across a fixed multi-joint test set against USD/Isaac and verify joint limits, units, frame convention, and gripper scalar mapping.
Verify the collision model against the same frozen RoboLab reset before any IKSolver call.
Record every verification hash and retain controller rejections outside behavioral denominators.
